Boskin to discuss Taiwan's importance to American security and the global economy, how China might seek to coerce or seize the island, and whether the United States is ready and capable of deterring its principal adversary in such an event. Freymann and Boskin examine the military balance of power in the Indo-Pacific, America's strained defense industrial base, and the growing importance of drones, artificial intelligence, cyber capabilities, and space systems. articles.original_title: Climate change may help eliminate malaria from West and Central Africa By the end of this century, malaria could be eradicated in West and Central Africa, two of the worst-affected regions. But this also means malaria is expected to become more pronounced in the cooler regions of Africa. “The overall story is that the burden is shifting,” says Tamma Carleton at the University of California, Berkeley.
